# WindowBase

**Class:** `UltraCanvasWindowBase` · **Group:** [Application, windows and dialogs](../Groups/Application-Windows-And-Dialogs.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasWindow.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasWindow.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasWindow.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A top-level window - itself a container, so elements are added to it with `AddChild`. Created with `CreateWindow(WindowConfig)`; `UltraCanvasWindow` is the platform's subclass.

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasTooltipManager](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTooltipManager.md)

- [UltraCanvasDropDownExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasDropDownExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasFileDialog](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasFileDialog.md)

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasWindowBase();
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
